Prototype Restoration 1.0 for Monster Party (USA)
Author and hacking: Cubivore10

Original source: https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/1516/
Current archive: https://www.romhack.ing/hacks/1516/

The included restoration.ips is the author's original, unmodified patch.
SHA-256: c5eac2f185abeefd585235516a5dadc4ef2c271794dd4bdb6906bc82d04e52d8
The patch is embedded in the executable and applied in memory only when enabled.
Your original ROM file is never changed. No complete game ROM is included.

Cubivore10 is credited for the restoration, not the recompiled port or its
widescreen implementation. The project's code license does not relicense this
third-party patch. Monster Party belongs to its respective rights holders.
